scope: Metadata-only descriptive cache opportunity audit; no model/GPU execution and no timing benefit claim
selection: First six episodes in frozen original100 order, selected before examining reuse; both complete FP16 and AWQ trajectories, cache reset each episode

definitions.adjacent_slot_hit: Current image occurrence hash occurs in previous actual model request, denominator current occurrences excluding first request
definitions.prior_request_slot_hit: Current occurrence hash occurs in any earlier actual model request of same episode; not within-current-request dedup
definitions.compute_misses_with_dedup: Distinct current hashes absent before request; exact JPEG byte SHA only, not a validated feature cache key
definitions.cold_first_request: First actual model request of each episode, with no prepopulation
definitions.lru: Per-episode simulation; process occurrences in prompt order; includes within-request duplicate hits

limitations: Small descriptive sample, not all navigation distribution.
JPEG byte identity does not prove changing-batch floating point feature equivalence.
FP16/AWQ closed-loop trajectories diverge; these percentages are not matched-load speed comparisons.
No prefix KV caching, input deletion, or visual token pruning has been tested or implied.
